questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी भारत में जनसंख्या वृद्धि की 'प्रावस्था-ग' की विशेषता है ?
questions.text_english: Which one of the following is the characteristic of 'Phase-III' of population growth in India?

options.A: महिलाओं की उच्च साक्षरता और घटती जनसंख्या
options.B: चिकित्सा सुविधाओं और जीवन की दशाओं में सुधार
options.C: महान आर्थिक मंदी और द्वितीय विश्व युद्ध के प्रभाव
options.D: कम जनसंख्या वृद्धि और कम शुद्ध वृद्धि

options_english.A: High female literacy and declining population
options_english.B: Improvisation in medical facilities and living conditions
options_english.C: Great Economic Depression and effects of World War II
options_english.D: Low population growth and low net increase

questions.solution: Phase III (1951-1981) in India is known as the period of population explosion, caused by a rapid decline in death rates and a sustained high birth rate due to improvements in medical facilities and public health.

questions.text:
'सामूहिक कृषि' से संबंधित निम्नलिखित विशेषताओं को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए।
I. यह उत्पादन के सामाजिक स्वामित्व और सामूहिक श्रम पर आधारित है।
II. यह पूर्व सोवियत संघ में प्रारम्भ की गई।
III. सभी किसान अपनी भूमि के आकार के अनुसार निवेश करते हैं।
IV. इस प्रकार की सामूहिक कृषि 'कोलकहोज़' के नाम से जानी जाती है।
questions.text_english:
Read the following characteristics related to 'collective farming' carefully and choose the correct option.
I. It is based on social ownership of production and collective labour.
II. It was introduced in erstwhile Soviet Union.
III. All farmers contribute the inputs according to their land size.
IV. This type of collective farming is called 'Kolkhoz'.

options.A: केवल I, II और IV सही हैं।
options.B: केवल I, III और IV सही हैं।
options.C: केवल II, III और IV सही हैं।
options.D: केवल I, II और III सही हैं。

options_english.A: Only I, II and IV are correct.
options_english.B: Only I, III and IV are correct.
options_english.C: Only II, III and IV are correct.
options_english.D: Only I, II and III are correct.

questions.solution: Collective farming is based on social ownership and collective labour (I). It originated in the Soviet Union (II) as Kolkhoz (IV). Statement III is incorrect because it is not based on individual land size but collective resources.

questions.text: नीचे दिए गए कथन संचार सेवाओं का वर्णन करते हैं। निम्नलिखित में से दूरसंचार की सबसे उपयुक्त विशेषताओं की पहचान कीजिए।
questions.text_english: The statements given below describe communication services. Identify the most appropriate characteristics of telecommunication from the following.

options.A: परिवहन के सभी रूपों को दूरसंचार का साधन कहा जाता है।
options.B: जहाँ परिवहन जाल-तंत्र सक्षम होता है, वहाँ दूरसंचार अधिक सफल होता है।
options.C: समाचार पत्र दूरसंचार के सबसे प्रभावी साधन हैं।
options.D: यह आधुनिक प्रौद्योगिकी के विकास और सूचना के उच्च गति प्रसार से जुड़ा हुआ है।

options_english.A: All forms of transport are referred to as means of telecommunication.
options_english.B: Where the transport network is efficient, telecommunication is very successful.
options_english.C: Newspapers are the most efficient means of telecommunication.
options_english.D: It is linked to the development of modern technology and high speed dissemination of information.

questions.solution: Telecommunication is defined by the use of modern technology to disseminate information at high speeds. Options A, B, and C are either incorrect or describe different types of communication.

questions.text:
पार-साइबेरियन रेलवे के निम्नलिखित स्टेशनों को पश्चिम से पूर्व स्थान की ओर व्यवस्थित कीजिए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए।
I. चिता
II. मॉस्को
III. ओम्स्क
IV. कज़ान
questions.text_english:
Arrange the following stations of Trans-Siberian Railway from west to east locations and choose the correct option.
I. Chita
II. Moscow
III. Omsk
IV. Kazan
questions.solution: The correct west to east sequence of these Trans-Siberian stations is Moscow (start), then Kazan, then Omsk, and finally Chita in the far east.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा पत्तन छोटी दूरी के लिए होता है ?
questions.text_english: Which one of the following ports is operational for shorter distances ?
questions.solution: Packet stations are specifically designed for ferry services across short water bodies to carry passengers and mail over short distances.

questions.text:
भारत की निम्नलिखित तेल शोधनशालाओं को उनके उत्तर से दक्षिण स्थान के क्रम में व्यवस्थित कीजिए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए।
I. मथुरा
II. बठिंडा
III. बीना
IV. पानीपत
questions.text_english:
Arrange the following oil refineries of India from their north to south locations and choose the correct option.
I. Mathura
II. Bathinda
III. Bina
IV. Panipat
questions.solution: The correct North to South order is Bathinda (Punjab), followed by Panipat (Haryana), then Mathura (UP), and finally Bina (MP).

questions.text:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं। ये अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) हैं। दोनों कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए।
अभिकथन (A) : स्वच्छंद उद्योग व्यापक विविधता वाले स्थानों में स्थित हो सकते हैं।
कारण (R) : स्वच्छंद उद्योगों की अवस्थिति परिवहन के जाल द्वारा अभिगम्यता से निर्धारित होती है।
questions.text_english:
Two statements are given below. They are Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Read both the statements carefully and choose the correct option.
Assertion (A): Foot loose industries can be located in a wide variety of places.
Reason (R): Location of foot loose industries is determined by transport network accessibility.

options.A: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं, लेकिन (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

options_english.A: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
options_english.B: Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).

questions.solution: Both statements are true: footloose industries can be anywhere, and they depend on transport. However, they are defined by not being dependent on raw material location, not just accessibility alone, so R is not the direct causal explanation for A.

questions.text:
अत्यधिक नगरीकृत क्षेत्रों में श्रमिकों का एक बहुत बड़ा अनुपात अन्य सेवाओं में लगा हुआ है। दिए गए कथन के संदर्भ में सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए।
I. बृहत् स्तर पर होने वाले नगरीकरण और औद्योगीकरण में अधिक श्रमिकों की आवश्यकता होती है।
II. ऐतिहासिक रूप से, यह देश की अर्थव्यवस्था में सेक्टरीय स्थानान्तरण है।
III. द्वितीयक सेक्टर में महिला श्रमिकों का प्रतिशत अपेक्षाकृत अधिक है।
IV. यह श्रमिकों का कृषि-आधारित रोज़गारों से गैर-कृषि-आधारित रोज़गारों में स्थानान्तरण है।
questions.text_english:
A very large proportion of workers are engaged in other services in highly urbanized areas. With reference to the given statement choose the correct option.
I. Large scale urbanisation and industrialisation require more workers.
II. Historically, it is a sectoral shift in the economy of the country.
III. Percentage of female workers is relatively high in secondary sector.
IV. It is a shift of workers from farm-based to non-farm-based occupations.

options.A: केवल I, II और III सही हैं।
options.B: केवल II, III और IV सही हैं।
options.C: केवल I, III और IV सही हैं।
options.D: केवल I, II और IV सही हैं।

options_english.A: Only I, II and III are correct.
options_english.B: Only II, III and IV are correct.
options_english.C: Only I, III and IV are correct.
options_english.D: Only I, II and IV are correct.

questions.solution: Statements I, II, and IV correctly explain the sectoral shift of labor due to urbanization and industrialization. Statement III is generally incorrect in the context of the Indian secondary sector.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा ग़लत सुमेलित है ?
सूची-I (शब्द) - सूची-II (अर्थ)
(A) कायिक घनत्व - कुल जनसंख्या/निवल कृषित क्षेत्र
(B) कृषीय घनत्व - कुल कृषि जनसंख्या/निवल कृषित क्षेत्र
(C) जनसंख्या घनत्व - कुल जनसंख्या/कुल क्षेत्रफल
(D) सीमांत श्रमिक - कुल जनसंख्या/कुल श्रमजीवी जनसंख्या
questions.text_english:
Which one of the following is incorrectly matched ?
List-I (Term) - List-II (Meaning)
(A) Physiological density - Total population/Net cultivated area
(B) Agricultural density - Total agricultural population/Net cultivable area
(C) Population density - Total population/Total area
(D) Marginal worker - Total population/Total working population
questions.solution: A, B, and C are correct definitions of population density types. Marginal worker (D) is not defined by this formula; a marginal worker is one who works for less than 183 days a year.
questions.chapter: Population: Distribution, Density, Growth and Composition

questions.text:
भारत में जनसंख्या वृद्धि की 'प्रावस्था-क' की विशेषताओं की पहचान कीजिए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए।
I. जनसंख्या वृद्धि की रुद्ध अवस्था
II. जनसंख्या की कम या ऋणात्मक शुद्ध वृद्धि
III. मृत्यु दर में तीव्र हास
IV. निम्न स्वास्थ्य एवं चिकित्सा सेवाएँ
questions.text_english:
Identify the characteristics of 'Phase-I' of population growth in India and choose the correct option.
I. Stagnant phase of population growth
II. Low or negative net growth of population
III. Rapid fall in the mortality rate
IV. Poor health and medical services

options.A: केवल I, II और III सही हैं।
options.B: केवल II, III और IV सही हैं।
options.C: केवल I, II और IV सही हैं।
options.D: केवल I, III और IV सही हैं।

options_english.A: Only I, II and III are correct.
options_english.B: Only II, III and IV are correct.
options_english.C: Only I, II and IV are correct.
options_english.D: Only I, III and IV are correct.

questions.solution: Phase I (1901-1921) was stagnant with low/negative growth (I, II) due to poor health/medical services (IV). Death rates were high, not low (III is incorrect).

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी किशोर जनसंख्या से संबंधित समाज के सम्मुख एक चुनौती नहीं है ?
questions.text_english: Which one of the following is not a challenge of adolescent population faced by the society?
questions.solution: Drug abuse (B), female illiteracy (C), and school dropouts (D) are major challenges. A high age of marriage is a positive social goal, not a challenge.

questions.text:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं। ये अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) हैं। दोनों कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए।
अभिकथन (A) : हाल के समय में कोलकाता समुद्री पत्तन का महत्त्व कम हो गया है।
कारण (R) : कोलकाता पत्तन हुगली नदी द्वारा लाई गई गाद की समस्या से जूझ रहा है।
questions.text_english:
Two statements are given below. They are Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Read both the statements carefully and choose the correct option.
Assertion (A): The significance of Kolkata sea port has declined in the recent times.
Reason (R): Kolkata port is confronted with the problem of silt accumulation in the Hugli river.

options.A: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं, लेकिन (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

options_english.A: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
options_english.B: Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).

questions.solution: The decline of Kolkata port is directly linked to the siltation of the Hugli river, which restricts the entry of large modern ships.

questions.text: सीमा सड़क संगठन का उद्देश्य है :
questions.text_english: The objective of Border Roads Organisation is:

options.A: मध्यम ऊँचाई वाले पठारी क्षेत्रों में सड़कों का निर्माण करना।
options.B: अति ऊँचाई वाले पहाड़ी क्षेत्रों में सड़कों का निर्माण करना।
options.C: निम्न मैदानी क्षेत्रों में सड़कों का निर्माण करना ।
options.D: बंदरगाहों को जोड़ने के लिए तटीय क्षेत्रों में सड़कों का निर्माण करना।

options_english.A: To construct roads in moderately elevated plateau areas.
options_english.B: To construct roads in high altitude mountainous terrains.
options_english.C: To construct roads in low lying plain areas.
options_english.D: To construct roads in coastal areas for linking ports.

questions.solution: The Border Roads Organisation (BRO) was established in 1960 for the development of roads of strategic importance in the northern and north-eastern border areas, primarily mountainous terrains.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित विशेषताओं को पढ़िए और फसल की पहचान कीजिए।
यह उष्णकटिबंधीय रोपण कृषि है और इसकी तीन किस्में हैं।
भारत के कुल उत्पादन का दो-तिहाई से अधिक अकेले कर्नाटक से आता है।
यह कर्नाटक और केरल के पश्चिम घाट की उच्च भूमि पर उगाई जाती है।
questions.text_english:
Read the following features and identify the crop.
It is a tropical plantation crop and has three varieties.
Karnataka alone accounts for more than two-third of its total production of India.
It is grown in the highlands of Western Ghats in Karnataka and Kerala.
questions.solution: Coffee is the tropical plantation crop that thrives in the highlands of the Western Ghats (Karnataka, Kerala), and Karnataka is the leading producer in India.

questions.text: जनांकिकीय संक्रमण सिद्धांत की निम्नलिखित अवस्थाओं में से किस एक में अशोधित जन्म दर और अशोधित मृत्यु दर के बीच उच्चतम अंतर पाया जाता है ?
questions.text_english: Which one of the following stages of demographic transition theory is an indicative of primitive stage?
questions.instruction_line: Study the following graph carefully and answer the questions no. 15 to 17:
questions.instruction_line_english: Study the following graph carefully and answer the questions no. 15 to 17:
questions.image_description: A line graph showing the Demographic Transition Theory with three stages (I, II, III). Stage I is marked as High Fluctuating with Bangladesh, Peru, and rainforest tribes as examples.
questions.solution: Stage I represents the primitive stage where both birth rates and death rates are high and fluctuating, resulting in little to no population growth.

questions.text: जनांकिकीय संक्रमण सिद्धांत के निम्नलिखित चरणों में से कौन-सा आदिम समाज का सूचक है ?
questions.text_english: The highest difference between the crude birth rate and crude death rate is observed in which one of the following stages of demographic transition theory?

options.B: अवस्था II के प्रथम भाग के अंत में
options.C: अवस्था II के दूसरे भाग के अंत में

options_english.B: End of the first part of stage II
options_english.C: End of the second part of stage II

questions.image_description: The graph shows birth rates remaining high while death rates start dropping rapidly in Stage II, creating the largest vertical gap between the two curves before birth rates start to fall in Stage III.
questions.solution: In the second part of Stage II, the birth rate remains high while the death rate has fallen significantly, leading to the maximum gap between the two and consequently, a population explosion.

questions.text: जनांकिकीय संक्रमण सिद्धांत की तीसरी अवस्था के दौरान जनसंख्या में शुद्ध वृद्धि में कमी निम्नलिखित में से किस कारण से है ?
questions.text_english: Net increase in population during third stage of demographic transition theory is low due to which one of the following reasons?

options.A: निम्न जन्म दर और निम्न मृत्यु दर
options.B: निम्न जन्म दर और उच्च मृत्यु दर
options.C: उच्च जन्म दर और निम्न मृत्यु दर
options.D: उच्च जन्म दर और उच्च मृत्यु दर

options_english.A: Low birth rate and low death rate
options_english.B: Low birth rate and high death rate
options_english.C: High birth rate and low death rate
options_english.D: High birth rate and high death rate

questions.image_description: The graph shows that in Stage III, both the birth rate and death rate lines converge at a lower level.
questions.solution: In Stage III, both the birth rate and death rate fall to low levels, which leads to a low net increase or stable population growth.

questions.text:
राईन जलमार्ग के मानचित्र का अध्ययन कीजिए और उसके नीचे दिए गए प्रश्नों के उत्तर लिखिए :
(18.1) राईन जलमार्ग के दोनों टर्मिनल पत्तनों की पहचान कीजिए।
(18.2) किन्हीं दो देशों की पहचान कीजिए जिनसे राईन जलमार्ग होकर जाता है।
(18.3) मानचित्र पर कौन-सी नदी पूर्व से राईन जलमार्ग में मिलती है ?
questions.text_english:
Study the map of the Rhine waterway and answer the questions that follow:
(18.1) Identify both the terminal ports of the Rhine waterway.
(18.2) Identify any two countries through which the Rhine waterway passes.
(18.3) On the map, which river joins the Rhine waterway from the east?

sub_questions.text: राईन जलमार्ग के दोनों टर्मिनल पत्तनों की पहचान कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Identify both the terminal ports of the Rhine waterway.

key_points: Rotterdam (Netherlands)
Basel (Switzerland)

sub_questions.solution: The two main terminal ports of the Rhine waterway are Rotterdam in the Netherlands and Basel in Switzerland.

sub_questions.text: किन्हीं दो देशों की पहचान कीजिए जिनसे राईन जलमार्ग होकर जाता है।
sub_questions.text_english: Identify any two countries through which the Rhine waterway passes.

key_points: Germany
Switzerland
Netherlands

sub_questions.text: मानचित्र पर कौन-सी नदी पूर्व से राईन जलमार्ग में मिलती है ?
sub_questions.text_english: On the map, which river joins the Rhine waterway from the east?

key_points: Main River

sub_questions.solution: The Main river joins the Rhine waterway from the east side.

questions.text_english: Tertiary activities are based on specialised skills, experience and knowledge of workers. Explain the statement.

key_points: Tertiary activities involve providing services rather than producing tangible goods.
Success in these fields (like consulting, medicine, teaching) depends on the individual's high level of specialized training.
Experience allows professionals to handle complex situations efficiently, adding value to the services provided.

questions.solution: Tertiary activities are service-oriented, unlike primary or secondary activities that produce tangible physical goods. Their quality and output are entirely dependent on the expertise and specialized skills of the workforce. Professionals such as doctors, teachers, and consultants provide value through their knowledge and experience. As these activities do not result in a physical product, the service itself becomes the commodity. Therefore, the higher the skill and experience of the worker, the more efficient and valuable the service becomes, which is why these activities are deeply rooted in specialized training.

questions.text_english:
(a) "Human geography is a highly interdisciplinary subject." Analyse the statement.
OR
(b) "Human geography tries to explain the relationship of human beings with the physical environs of their occupance." Analyse the statement.

key_points: Interdisciplinary nature links geography with history, sociology, and economics.
Studies human society's interaction with the environment.
Evolves as a dynamic science to understand human adaptation.

questions.solution: Human geography is considered a highly interdisciplinary subject because it studies the complex interactions between human societies and their environment by borrowing concepts and methodologies from various fields such as sociology, economics, history, and political science. It does not exist in isolation; instead, it integrates insights from these disciplines to provide a comprehensive understanding of human activities, population patterns, and settlements. By linking these social sciences with physical geography, it becomes a dynamic field that explains how human life adapts to, modifies, and thrives within diverse geographical settings, proving that geographical phenomena cannot be understood without considering their social and economic context.

questions.text_english: Rama has been given the responsibility of preparing a development programme for a hilly area. Explain any three points which should be kept in mind while preparing the programme.

key_points: Focus on sustainable mountain agriculture and forestry.
Improving basic infrastructure while respecting fragile terrain.
Emphasizing local participation and traditional knowledge.

questions.solution: To develop a successful program for a hilly area, Rama should first prioritize sustainable and eco-friendly infrastructure development that respects the fragile topography to prevent soil erosion and landslides. Second, the program should focus on promoting mountain-specific agriculture, such as horticulture and plantation crops, which are economically viable without causing ecological degradation. Finally, it is crucial to ensure community participation, leveraging the traditional knowledge of local residents who best understand the environment. This holistic approach ensures that the development is socially inclusive, economically beneficial to the local population, and environmentally sound for the long term.

questions.text_english: "Equity refers to making equal access to opportunities available to everybody." Analyse the statement in context to an important pillar of human development.

key_points: Equity is a core pillar of human development.
Ensures no one is excluded based on gender, caste, or race.
Focuses on removing barriers for marginalized groups.
Essential for societal justice and individual empowerment.
Promotes equality of opportunity.

questions.solution: Equity is a fundamental pillar of human development, emphasizing the necessity of providing equal access to opportunities for every individual, regardless of their background. It argues that all people, irrespective of their gender, race, income, or caste, should have the same chance to thrive and contribute to society. In many developing societies, deep-rooted social and economic disparities often exclude marginalized groups from education, healthcare, and job opportunities. Equity calls for affirmative policies and structural changes to remove these barriers, ensuring that the fruits of development are accessible to all. By promoting equal opportunity, equity not only fosters social justice but also maximizes the overall human capital potential, which is essential for comprehensive national growth and individual empowerment.

questions.text_english:
(a) "In India, sea ports have emerged as gateways of international trade." Substantiate the statement.
OR
(b) "Satellites are mode of communication in themselves as well as they regulate the use of other means of communication." Substantiate the statement.

key_points: Sea ports are India's lifeline for international trade.
Facilitate import and export of bulk cargo like oil, coal, and minerals.
Connect India with global markets.
Modern ports are essential for industrial development and economic growth.
Examples include Mumbai, Chennai, and Kandla ports.

questions.solution: Sea ports act as essential gateways for India's international trade, serving as the main points of entry and exit for goods in the global market. Given India's extensive coastline, ports like Mumbai, Kandla, Chennai, and Kolkata handle a vast majority of the country's trade volume, especially for bulk commodities like crude oil, minerals, coal, and manufactured items. These ports are integral to the global supply chain, allowing India to import critical technological components and resources while exporting agricultural and finished goods. Modern infrastructure at these ports has significantly streamlined customs and cargo handling, reducing shipping times and logistics costs. Consequently, sea ports remain the primary engines that drive India's international economic integration and industrial success.

questions.solution: Market gardening and horticulture are characterized by intensive production methods aimed at supplying high-value, perishable goods directly to urban centers. Because crops like vegetables, fruits, and flowers have a short shelf life, this type of agriculture requires high investment in infrastructure, including fast transportation networks and efficient cold storage facilities. The specialization allows farmers to focus on high-demand items that fetch a premium price, maximizing profits per unit of land. This intensive use of labor and technology ensures that fresh produce reaches consumers daily, meeting the sophisticated demands of urban lifestyles. Consequently, these sectors represent a sophisticated, specialized agricultural practice that is crucial for meeting urban food needs efficiently.

key_points: Agriculture is the largest consumer of freshwater in India.
Irrigation is crucial due to monsoonal variations.
Excessive use leads to groundwater depletion.
Need for water-saving techniques like drip irrigation.
Balancing water allocation for drinking vs agriculture.

questions.solution: In India, the demand for water is overwhelmingly driven by agricultural needs, primarily for irrigation. Because India's rainfall is highly seasonal and unreliable, large-scale irrigation systems are required to ensure food security for its massive population. Agriculture consumes the vast majority of extracted freshwater, often leading to rapid groundwater depletion in several regions where tube wells are over-utilized. While domestic and industrial needs are also growing, the sheer scale of irrigation remains the primary stressor on India's hydrological resources. This reliance on water-intensive cropping patterns necessitates a shift toward more sustainable practices, such as precision farming and better water management techniques, to balance the competing demands of an growing economy and a water-stressed landscape.

key_points: Migration is often a response to rural underdevelopment.
Urban areas offer better jobs and infrastructure, creating a 'pull' factor.
Resulting in overcrowding and strain on urban services.
Rural areas face 'brain drain' and loss of young labor.
Uneven development leads to socio-economic imbalances.

questions.solution: The large-scale migration from rural to urban areas in India is a clear indicator of the skewed development patterns between these regions. Urban centers are often perceived as hubs of better employment, education, and healthcare, acting as 'pull' factors that draw people away from underdeveloped rural areas, where employment is primarily low-income, subsistence farming. This migration pattern often results in overcrowding and immense pressure on urban infrastructure, such as slums and strained sanitation services. Conversely, rural regions face the loss of their most productive and young labor force, known as the 'brain drain', which hinders their own development efforts. This cycle confirms that rural and urban growth is not synchronized, creating significant socio-economic disparities across the country.
